script_text: Pisces, your Water energy faces a major love and money turning point this week. Monday to Wednesday, Neptune in your 1st House trines Jupiter in your 5th House, boosting romance and career ideas. Tuesday is rough because Mars in your 9th House squares Saturn, so delay travel and avoid heated partner arguments. Thursday turns when Venus enters your 7th House and sextiles Jupiter, bringing a serious partner or client into focus. Thursday to Sunday, the Moon in your 10th House opposes Neptune, so verify vague work promises before spending money. By the weekend, Mercury in your 4th House trines ruling planet Jupiter, healing tension and helping love succeed. Friday is your power day because Venus in your 7th House trines Jupiter. Tuesday is hardest because Mars squares Saturn in your 9th House. Write goals Thursday and wait for written confirmation first. Follow for daily updates.
